notes.content:

notes.title: 0.1.1 Update patch notes
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057795/7b14a4721951007c25ab95a2ebdce447df3d7ae5.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057795/7b2b8563795ee0e966f1e45c75973c968dbfe30b.jpg[/img][/url]
-Air supply has been added. A helicopter will drop a supply box in an area close to the crashed helicopter.
Wood can now be added to campfires in camps. You can get warm and burn.
-AI remote hit bug has been updated.
-More soldiers have been added to the safe zone. For the locals not to enter.
-Item boxes are now more advanced and getting difficult to interact bugs have been fixed.
Fixed the issue where some texts in the language option were not displayed.
-Fog bugs in the player camera have been fixed.
You can move a little faster when you need a toilet.


Stay tuned for more updates. Please note that the game is in early access. Thank you for supporting us.
